methodology: Ring Opening Metathesis Polymerization (ROMP) was employed to integrate various functional side chains into the polymer structure for the synthesis of a polymeric fluorescent chemosensor probe. The ROMP process utilized a Grubbs catalyst to achieve this integration.
research_objective: To develop and synthesize a multifunctional polymeric fluorescent chemosensor probe capable of selective detection of Cu2+, Arg, and other metal ions for biosensing applications in food science.

key_findings.finding: Synthesis of a polymeric fluorescent chemosensor probe using Coumarin (Cou) and Tryptophan Multi-response (Trp)-derived norbornene (NB) monomers through Ring Opening Metathesis Polymerization (ROMP).
